question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
-- Calculate median of highest season goals per team
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id, season
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id, season
),
team_season_totals AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, season, SUM(total_goals) AS season_total
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_api_id, season
),
highest_season_goals AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, MAX(season_total) AS highest_goals
    FROM team_season_totals
    GROUP BY team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT highest_goals,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY highest_goals) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
    FROM highest_season_goals
)
SELECT AVG(highest_goals) AS median_highest_season_goals
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2);

team_season_totals AS (
